term: beginning (description in the narrow Hume reading)
definition: A description of an object absent at one moment and existent at the next, the temporal contrast in I.3.3 §3. No formal time ontology is inferred: the Lean parameter uncausedBeginning names that description and remains an interpretation parameter.
note: Local reading interface for issue #248; no account of causal production or temporal ontology is supplied. A more substantive formalization needs its own source-backed account.
